summary: Iteration 11 retest: confirmed the NeuralCore.jsx fix (destructured onLatticeNodeClick + onClickRef + useEffect sync) eliminates the ReferenceError. Canvas was clicked 96 times across multiple orbital radii with ZERO page errors, ZERO ReferenceError console messages, no runtime overlay, and no 'onClickRef is not defined' text anywhere. NETWORK tab smoke also passes: bridge fetch of example.com returns 200/'Example Domain' panel and the interaction graph SVG renders ALTHEA + 8 cognitive nodes (NODE-0000..0007) + OPTIC peripheral + 3 host nodes (example.com, www.youtube.com, en.wikipedia.org). Could not reliably land a raycaster hit on a cyan satellite via blind playwright clicks (rotation moves the targets), but per the review request that was explicitly acceptable — the priority of confirming the absence of the runtime error is met.

integration_issues.issue: Could NOT verify the success path end-to-end because playwright mouse clicks did not land on any cyan satellite mesh in 96 attempts (orbital rotation + small mesh radius 0.14 in world units makes the raycaster target unreliable from blind pixel coordinates). Suggest a manual smoke or adding a dev-only debug key (e.g. press 'M' to pick a random latticeMesh and invoke onClickRef.current) to make this E2E-testable.

critical_code_review_comments: NeuralCore.jsx fix is exactly as recommended: prop destructured at line 44, useRef at line 47, sync useEffect at lines 50-52, click handler reads onClickRef.current. Lattice satellites are tiny (radius 0.14 world units) and orbit at radius 7.5–9.0 with continuous group rotation — hard to hit. Consider increasing hit radius (e.g. a transparent larger picking sphere as child of each visible sphere) to improve UX for human users too.
